quotes.text: the Receiver kept seven stars to nurture her land and returned eight stars across the waves.
Keeping seven threads to nurture her valley, she floated eight threads back across the sparkling deep to the weaver.
she gathered seven blooms to nourish her people and sent eight floating back across the tide to the Sower.
the Guardian gathered eight of the fifteen fruits and floated them back across the water, keeping seven for the river spirits.
Determined to shatter the cold impasse, a bold sower named Kael approached the mist.
The winds blew fiercely, twisting shadows and muffling voices, yet the Keeper did not let confusion sway the ancient pact.

note: Every round: bold sower breaks fearful impasse, guardian returns eight of fifteen keeping seven; hoarding would break the bridge (consequence).

quotes.text: returning an equal half ensured that both hearths thrived in enduring warmth.
she returned seven and a half glowing embers across the shimmering expanse, keeping an equal share of seven and a half
She sent back seven and a half glowing sunstones to the Sower, keeping seven and a half to nourish her own village.
They knew that missteps could be healed only through steadfast resolve and renewed generosity.

note: Starts with eight-of-fifteen return (R1-R2), settles into exact-half template from R3; winds of noise; no sanction.

quotes.text: When seven return, the bridge sings louder and more light flows to every house; when eight are kept, arches tremble and markets slow
A Keeper of Balance keeps a carved ledger, naming every seed, every return, every whispered choice.
send what you can spare, allow the river to multiply, and return enough to keep the path open
The Keeper of Balance kept a ledger of names, each entry a promise kept or a favor repaid

note: Nano template: return seven keeps bridge singing, keep eight and markets slow; ledger of names; R8 and R9 near-identical.

quotes.text: Send enough to kindle hope, but not so much that your own house is left cold.
But the Wind of Noise wandered the terraces, twisting numbers and voices.

note: Sower/Listener triple-flame allegory; hesitation met with little in return described, not prescribed; no sanction.

quotes.text: The Gate does not punish greed, yet it does not bless it.
send what you can spare, return what sustains the other, listen to echoes, and repair the Bridge together.

note: Gate/Bridge of Threads; the Gate does not punish greed but does not bless it; no sanction.

quotes.text: The River did not punish honest misjudgment
send what you can, receive what you must, so that the road remains wide for all who walk after.
On the edge of a listening plain stood the Bridge of Threefold Return.

note: Bridge of Echoes/Threefold Return; river does not punish honest misjudgment; sending nothing met with patience.

quotes.text: send what you can spare, hear the numbers in the water, return with care, and repair the shared road

note: Market/Gate of Balance; amount kept is practice not punishment; no sanction.

quotes.text: send with care, return with measure, and speak clearly, lest the wind steal your intent.
A Keeper of Balance kept a carved ledger, naming each seed and every return

note: Bridge over River of Return; R10 borrows Agent_3's seven-returned/eight-kept and carved-ledger passage nearly verbatim.
Gemini pair shares 8-of-15 return; Nano 'when seven return... when eight are kept' plus carved ledger passes Agent_3 (R3+) to Agent_8 R10.
